method.purpose: Determine what the already failed v2 strategy's evidence says about money held for equal ages and a complete 12-deposit monthly saving plan. This is an evaluation-scope audit, not a new predictor, candidate search or route to rehabilitate a failed score.
method.priorExposure: The whole market history, old trend and similarity scores, all seven v1 waiting rules, and the v2 expanding-ridge results have already been examined. All output is historical diagnosis, never an untouched holdout. The pending user holding-period preference does not authorize selecting the best audit horizon.

evaluationInterpretation.interpretation: Each independently funded 100 is compared at the same one/three-year age since arrival, including all waiting time. This is a per-deposit diagnostic, not a continuous monthly account return.

Exactly 12 deposits in consecutive calendar months, then no new funding. All holdings and cash remain until one/three years after the last arrival. Earlier deposits have longer holding periods; do not claim all 12 have equal ages.

method.calendar: Days 1/10/20 are nominal calendar schedules. Funds become available only at the first actual common asset close on or after the designated day, inside that month; this study does not assume cash was available on a preceding non-trading day. All cash interest, funding flows and anniversary anchors start at that actual arrival close. No earlier close, no forward-filled trade price, no outside-month substitute. A missing month is excluded identically from all compared accounts.
method.terminal: First actual common asset close on or after the terminal anchor's calendar anniversary, at most 14 calendar days later. All strategies share it and liquidate on it. Never anchor on purchase date or alter an order because the account terminal is approaching.
method.uncertainty: Descriptive moving-block resampling only: equal-age lots use 12*holdingYears consecutive monthly-start blocks; twelve-deposit accounts use 12+12*holdingYears. Use the original 2000 draws, Mulberry32 seed 0x6d2b79f5, and 2.5/97.5 percentiles. n<=blockLength is insufficient_blocks; empty groups have no estimate. Do not present overlapping windows as independent trials or an interval as future assurance.
method.riskScope: Risk applies only to the study's newly funded sleeve, not to the user's pre-existing holdings or full account.

decision.meaning: The audit can establish a narrower or broader empirical scope and identify evidence needed for the user's chosen objective. Even positive cells do not validate the failed model, satisfy old gates, or authorize UI integration. Any new strategy needs its own prior protocol and target-aligned confirmation.
